name: Immigrant Investor Programme (IIP)

requirements.blocker_text: This route closed to new applicants at close of business 15 February 2023, closed by then-Justice Minister Simon Harris. No successor investor programme has been announced. Applications on hand at closure continued to be processed under a seven-tier priority system; existing approved projects remain unaffected and can still source investors.

sources.title: Minister Harris announces closure of the Immigrant Investor Programme - Government of Ireland

notes: THIRD CONFIRMED FULL-CLOSURE CASE in this dataset, joining es_golden_visa (fully abolished, no successor) and au_national_innovation_858 (consolidated into a talent visa) — Ireland's version most closely resembles Spain's: a clean, total closure with genuinely no successor programme, superseded_by explicitly null. Historic terms for reference: €1m approved investment or philanthropic donation. Real historical scale confirmed via reputable press (Irish Times, 26 April 2024): 'Some €1.25 billion was raised... There were 1,275 Chinese applications in 2022 alone, a rate close to 25 each week' — genuinely large volume right up to closure, making this a real and consequential program shutdown rather than a minor or little-used route being retired. ie_start_up_entrepreneur_programme (STEP) remains the open entrepreneur alternative, though it operates on a materially different, non-passive-investment model (business plan and job creation rather than a fixed capital sum).
